main.description: Read the status of one batch/v1 Job in the named cluster of the calling account, with the pods it owns and the tail of each container's log, without a kubeconfig. Pairs with kubectlApplyServerSide: apply a Job, then poll this until phase is Succeeded or Failed. Read as the account's own ServiceAccount in that cluster. Requires a service-auth JWT from the caller's own PDS whose lxm is this method.

cluster.description: The cluster label of the calling account.

tailLines.description: How many log lines to return per container, from the end. Default 100; 0 returns no logs. Each log is also capped at 64 KiB.

phase.description: Succeeded: the Complete (or SuccessCriteriaMet) condition is True. Failed: the Failed (or FailureTarget) condition is True. Running: at least one pod is active. Pending otherwise, which includes waiting for a node: a tenant cluster at zero nodes rents a market VM for the Job's pod first.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A parameter is missing or out of range.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token, or its aud or lxm does not match.

errors.name: IdentityRevoked
errors.description: The caller's identity carries a deny record.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: This account has no cluster of that name.

errors.name: ClusterNotRunning
errors.description: The control plane is stopped (409). Call controlPlaneUp first.

errors.name: ClusterInitializing
errors.description: The control plane is coming up (429, Retry-After). Retry.

errors.name: ClusterUnavailable
errors.description: The gateway could not get a credential for the cluster or the cluster did not answer (503).

errors.name: ObjectNotFound
errors.description: No Job of that name in that namespace (404).

errors.name: KubernetesError
errors.description: The apiserver refused the read; message is the apiserver's message.

log.description: The last tailLines lines of the container's log (at most 64 KiB).

logError.description: Why the log could not be read, when it could not.
